gate.feature: Count of non-null ddcParabolicResidualMs among the frozen targets in each song/fold
gate.foldTargetCountPolicy: Use actual frozen fold sizes; no equal-size assumption. The absolute threshold remains 10 raw candidates in each fold
gate.rule: Enable the E9 hierarchical method for the whole song only when both odd and even folds each have at least 10 raw DDC candidates; otherwise use E5 for every object in that song
gate.timing: Freeze threshold and rule before reading gate counts or E10 metrics

configuration.enabledSongMethod: Reuse E9 exactly: DDC raw candidate with its opposite-fold DDC correction when supported, E5 correction fallback otherwise; E5 full candidate when DDC is missing
configuration.disabledSongMethod: Reuse E5 calibrated candidate and error unchanged for every object
configuration.selectionPolicy: One deterministic label-free whole-song gate; no sample-id whitelist, error threshold, post-hoc override or per-object method selection beyond the frozen E9 fallback
configuration.primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, missing candidates incorrect
guardrails: sample-044 audible correct rate at least 80%
gate uses no labels, errors, weights or calibration-support records

hypotheses.H1: E10 improves weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E5
hypotheses.H2: E10 has positive net fixed weight, preserves sample-044 at least 80%, and does not increase no-clear output rate
hypotheses.H3: Every whole-song gate can be reconstructed using only segmentId/sampleId/fold/raw DDC candidate availability, without current-fold or opposite-fold labels

configuration.testPolicy: Exactly one minimum-10-raw-candidates-per-fold whole-song gate using actual fold sizes; no threshold sweep, direct-DDC alternative, rematching, new inference or per-song override
configuration.confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
